name: acp-client
description: Agent Client Protocol client for VS Code — connect to GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Kiro CLI, Hermes Agent, and any ACP-compatible AI coding agent

viewsWelcome.contents:
No agents configured.
[Add Agent](command:acp.addAgent)
Configure agents in settings or browse the [Agent Registry](command:acp.browseRegistry).

view/item/context.when: view == acp-sessions && (viewItem =~ /^session/ || viewItem == local-no-delete || viewItem == session-local-no-delete)

acp.agents.description: Agent configurations. Each key is the agent name, value has command, args, and env. Cursor defaults to cursor-agent acp (on PATH); falls back to cursor-acp if cursor-agent is missing.

acp.autoApprovePermissions.description: Automatically approve agent permission requests. 'ask' always prompts, 'allowAll' approves everything, 'remember' auto-approves commands and tools you have approved before (persisted across sessions).

acp.approvedCommands.description: List of normalized commands that have been approved by the user and will be auto-approved in 'remember' mode.

acp.approvedTools.description: Fingerprints of non-command tools (e.g. Kiro subagent crew) approved via allow_always / remember. Survives VS Code reload.

acp.deniedCommands.description: List of command prefixes that are always denied (auto-rejected). Merged with built-in denylist (rm -rf, sudo, etc.).

acp.defaultWorkingDirectory.description: Default working directory for agent sessions. Leave empty to use the current workspace folder.

acp.debug.description: Master debug switch. When enabled, verbose diagnostics such as [FORK-DEBUG] (fork-to-agent memory/skill injection) are logged to the ACP Client output channel.

acp.debugResume.description: Log session resume/load diagnostics ([WV-DIAG], [WV-MERGE], user_message_chunk turn boundaries) to the ACP Client output channel and ~/.cursor/acp-debug/resume-diag.jsonl. Enable when debugging collapsed-block splits after reload.

acp.compaction.hookWatcher.description: Watch ~/.cursor/acp-debug/compaction-events.jsonl (from the preCompact hook) and reset memory-inject gates when Cursor auto-compacts. Install the hook with scripts/install-precompact-hook.ps1 or .sh.

acp.autoSteerQueuedMessages.description: Push a message typed mid-turn into the RUNNING turn (session/steer) instead of queueing it for the next one. Off by default: the agent may answer only the most recent interjection, so an earlier one can go unanswered. With it off, queued messages drain strictly in order, one per turn, and the Steer button on a queued message still delivers it immediately when you want that.

acp.logTraffic.description: Log all ACP protocol traffic to the output channel.

acp.logTrafficMaxEntries.description: Maximum number of entries kept in the ACP Traffic output channel before it is cleared. Prevents unbounded memory growth in long sessions.

acp.sessionSummary.endpoint.description: responses-vllm-proxy base URL for /session summarization (POST /v1/summarize-session). Matches Pi vllm-proxy provider baseUrl without /v1.

acp.sessionSummary.apiKey.description: Optional Bearer token for the vLLM proxy when api-keys are enabled.

acp.sessionSummary.model.description: Model alias (resolved by the proxy) used for /session summarization. Set empty to use the proxy's auto-selection (largest context).

acp.sessionSummary.fallbackEndpoint.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL used as fallback when the primary summarize endpoint fails (proxy down, timeout, non-OK response). Recommended: https://api.deepseek.com (official DeepSeek API, POST /v1/chat/completions — verified via api-docs.deepseek.com). Empty = fallback disabled.

acp.sessionSummary.fallbackApiKey.description: Bearer token for the fallback endpoint (a DeepSeek API key from platform.deepseek.com). Empty = fallback disabled.

acp.sessionSummary.fallbackModel.description: Model id used by the fallback endpoint (DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731, 1M-token context).

acp.memory.enabled.description: Enable TencentDB Agent Memory (Model B): shared team memory with per-agent profiles (codex/claude/kiro/…). Requires a running MemoryCore Gateway.

acp.memory.endpoint.description: MemoryCore Gateway base URL (no trailing slash).

acp.memory.serviceId.description: Memory instance / space id (x-tdai-service-id). Shared by all ACP agents.

acp.memory.teamId.description: Team id for Model B isolation. Shared by all ACP agents so team-visible Skills/Knowledge can be shared.

acp.memory.userId.description: User id for memory isolation (shared across Windows/Mac). Use one canonical id (e.g. zaedinzeng). Empty defaults to zaedinzeng — not the OS username.

acp.memory.agentIdMap.description: Optional map of ACP agent config name → MemoryCore agent_id. Unmapped names use built-in heuristics (Codex→codex, Claude→claude, Kiro→kiro, …).

acp.memory.recallMaxResults.description: Max L1 atomic memories to inject on each prompt.

acp.memory.minScore.description: Minimum relevance score for L1 memory injection. Memories below this threshold are excluded. 0 = no filtering (all memories injected).

acp.memory.includePersona.description: Include L3 persona (core) for the agent profile on recall.

acp.memory.includeSceneNav.description: Include L2 scenario navigation index for the agent profile on recall.

acp.memory.includeSkills.description: Include extracted skills (names + descriptions) in the recall blob on every prompt.

acp.memory.skillCharBudget.description: Maximum character budget for the skills section in the recall blob.

acp.memory.captureEnabled.description: Write L0 conversation turns to MemoryCore after each prompt completes.

acp.memory.timeoutMs.description: HTTP timeout for MemoryCore Gateway requests (milliseconds).

acp.memory.recallRetryCount.description: Retries per gateway request after transient network errors (fetch failed, connection refused). 0 disables retries.

acp.memory.recallRetryDelayMs.description: Delay between memory gateway retry attempts (milliseconds).

acp.memory.debug.description: Verbose timing/debug logging for memory recall + injection (per-call latency, total recall time, injection-vs-prompt-send timing). Written to the 'ACP Client' output channel.
